items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns, CFO Colette Kress named interim chief
items.summary: Nvidia's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation as President, CEO and board member, effective immediately, per a November 11 SEC Form 8-K. CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO while keeping her CFO title, and Harvey C. Jones becomes the company's first independent Board Chair. The board is searching for a permanent successor; no cause was given, though it follows reports of a board probe into a personal relationship of Huang's with a China-linked individual.
items.whyItMatters: Nvidia GPUs sit underneath nearly every LLM and voice-model vendor the tutor depends on, so a sudden, unexplained change at the top is worth tracking for downstream supply and pricing risk, even with no product impact yet.

items.title: Apple HomeView smart display ships today with Siri AI (beta)
items.summary: Apple's $299 HomeView — a 7-inch, A18-chip smart home display in tabletop and wall-mounted models — goes on sale November 13 in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and Singapore. It launches with the new Siri AI in beta, working in English at launch; Canadian French support is reported to follow later.
items.whyItMatters: A mainstream ambient voice-assistant device betting on conversational Siri AI is a useful signal for what a 'kitchen counter' French tutor experience could look like — and the delayed French rollout underlines how hard multilingual voice UX still is even for Apple.
